maya: Hey SREs — quick Q. I got paged for inference-runtime SLO burn this morning (high burn rate alert). Where's the single place to pull raw traces + per-route error breakdown to share with the service PO? Also which alert fired exactly?

josh: @maya — open Grafana -> SLOs (team-inference) dashboard. Panel name: "inference-runtime | error budget burn (24h)". Quick link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd123/inference-slos?orgId=1 

josh: PromQL we usually use for the burn panel: 
```
sum(rate(slo_errors_total{service="inference-runtime"}[5m])) / sum(rate(slo_requests_total{service="inference-runtime"}[5m]))
```
Set the time range to 24h to match the alert window.

josh: For logs (per-route breakdown) hit Loki — query by label then parse JSON: 
```
{job="inference", service="inference-runtime"} | json | rate(status_code >= 500)[1h]
```
That gives you which endpoint and model triggered 5xx spikes.

olivia: If you want traces, Tempo search works: filter on `service=inference-runtime` + `slo=true` tag. Example trace link (internal): https://tempo.redwood.internal/traces/trace-id-xxxx. Use span name `request` and look at `http.target` for route.

devon: FYI the alert that paged you was `SLOHighBurnRate` in Alertmanager. The rule is: burn_rate > 3.0 for 30m (we bumped from 2.0 in Nov). See Alertmanager link: https://alertmanager.redwood.internal/#/alerts?filter=SLOHighBurnRate

devon: If we're seeing noisy sources (model A warmup), we could tune the label filters or add route-level exclude for short-running health-checks. Worth discussing before lowering threshold.

sre-bot: [alert] SLOHighBurnRate fired for inference-runtime @ 2026-02-21T09:12:03Z. Current burn: 3.6x, window=30m. AlertID=AM-78912. Incident runbook: https://wiki.redwood.internal/sre/runbooks/slo-burn

maya: Thanks all — I'll grab the Grafana panel and Loki queries and attach to the ticket. @devon can you copy the runbook tweaks for model warmup exclusion? I'll also ask PO if they want a temporary reduction to 2.5x while we investigate. :thumbsup:

josh: Also useful: check the per-route tokenization panel (seq length distribution) — long tails will inflate cost and errors. Panel: `inference-runtime -> seq dist`.

olivia: If anyone needs a quick trace sample, DM me the trace id and I can pull the full span timeline.

maya: Looks good. Closing the loop here once I have the ticket updated with links and screenshots.
